# Azita Mehrabi

> Hand-knotted rugs and kilim cushions. A rug room in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Hand-knotted rugs and runners in wool and wool with silk highlights, kilim cushion covers cut from older flatweave, rug pads and cotton binding tape. Every piece is one piece and is listed with its size, knot count, pile height, fibre and wear. No age, origin or investment claims. Sold by enquiry through the form; mailbox studio@azitamehrabi.com.

## Pages
- https://azitamehrabi.com/ — the room, what is in it, how a piece leaves it, questions asked at the counter
- https://azitamehrabi.com/rugs-and-runners.html — the five lines of every note, field and border, runners, silk highlights, the knot reckoner
- https://azitamehrabi.com/kilim-cushions.html — how a cover is cut from a flatweave, backing and zip, insert size, why two covers differ
- https://azitamehrabi.com/sizes-and-care.html — measuring a floor, the floor reckoner, pads, turning, vacuuming and fringe, what the room will not do
- https://azitamehrabi.com/ask-about-a-piece.html — the form

## Not done here
No cleaning, repair or restoration. No valuations. No fitting or laying. No shipping outside Canada.
